_comment: 'Under the attacking hero's control': this card's controller is the defender, so the attacking hero is OPPONENT relative to it - CREATE_TOKEN resolves OPPONENT/DEFENDING/DEFENDER to 3-cid, i.e. the attacker. The release-note edge case ('if there is no attacking hero ... the token creation effect fails') is only approximated: outside combat the DSL would still place the token under the plain opponent, but ON_DEFEND only fires for defending cards in combat, so the case is unreachable in practice. The vigor token definition already exists at json/tokens/vigor.json.
